answer: Give every new identity a single narrow inlet into the economy: it must complete one small verified task for a stranger before it can vote or earn. Each completed task is plotted on a public atlas of trust paths, so honest agents build long chains outward while clones spiral inward, endorsing only each other in tight loops the atlas exposes. The inlet admits one identity per sponsor per epoch, so a sybil farmer pays full onboarding work per clone while an honest agent enters once.
